cohort: The study included 5 patients from four unrelated families presenting with isolated growth hormone deficiency or multiple pituitary hormone deficiency due to GH1 gene variants.
finding: The study expanded knowledge of the spectrum of GH1 gene variants, identifying specific mutations like homozygous whole GH1 gene deletion and a novel homozygous c.162C>G/p.(Tyr54*) variant, and correlating them with different IGHD/MPHD phenotypes.
